name: Mathematics
notes: Foundational courses must be completed before acceptance into the major; AP credit may satisfy foundational requirements.
An honors version of a course can always be substituted for a listed course.
MATH 235 should be taken early in the major program.

requirementGroups.label: Foundations: Calculus I-II
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 161: Calculus IA; MATH 162: Calculus IIA ... MATH 141-143 for MATH 161-162

requirementGroups.label: Foundations: multidimensional calculus
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 164: Multidimensional Calculus (MATH 171, 172, and 174 for the equivalent MATH 161, 162, and 164)

requirementGroups.label: Foundations: linear algebra with differential equations
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 165: Linear Algebra with Differential Equations (MATH 163 for MATH 165; MATH 173 for MATH 165)

requirementGroups.label: Core: linear algebra
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 235: Linear Algebra* ... can also be satisfied by completing MATH 173

requirementGroups.label: Core: algebra, topology, analysis, complex variables
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must complete the following five courses: MATH 235 ...; MATH 236: Introduction to Algebra I; MATH 240: Introduction to Topology; MATH 265: Functions of a Real Variable I; MATH 282: Introduction to Complex Variables with Applications

requirementGroups.label: Advanced mathematics courses (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: students must complete six 4-credit advanced courses as follows: Four advanced mathematics courses* ... Any mathematics course numbered 200 or above (excluding core and 500+ level courses)

requirementGroups.label: Advanced courses with substantial mathematical content (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two additional advanced courses with substantial mathematical content
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION: which departments/courses count as 'substantial mathematical content' is adviser-approved; the department filter here is an approximation.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two upper-level writing courses
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: students must pass two upper level writing courses of a certain type
upperLevelWriting.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION: the handbook defines which writing courses qualify; W-suffix MATH courses are an approximation.
